title: Spongent S-box Implementation Cost
summary: No operation-count figures were found in the literature for the Spongent S-box; determine its minimum implementation cost or establish the best-known cost.

formal_statement.body: Determine the minimum, or establish the best-known, implementation cost of the Spongent S-box, measured by the numbers of binary $\operatorname{XOR}$ operations, binary $\operatorname{AND}/\operatorname{OR}$ operations, and unary $\operatorname{NOT}$ operations. No such operation-count figures were found in the literature.

scope.domain: Implementation optimization for the Spongent S-box in symmetric cryptography.
parameters: Counts of binary XOR, binary AND/OR, and unary NOT operations as the implementation-cost measure
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the minimum cost under these operation counts, or establish the best-known implementation cost for the Spongent S-box.

progress.summary: The source surveys minimum operation-count implementations found in the literature and reports that no corresponding figures were found for Spongent, leaving its minimum or best-known cost unresolved.
citation_labels: Nicolas Bordes et al., Thinking Outside the Superbox
